title: Night Cream with Vitamin C: Benefits and How to Use It
ex: What vitamin C does in a night cream, how it helps dull or uneven-looking skin, and what to compare on price in India.
rt: Night Cream with Vitamin C: Benefits & Use | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream with vitamin C: benefits for dull and uneven-looking skin, cream vs serum, how to use it at night and what to compare on price in India.
quick: A night cream with vitamin C can help dull, tired-looking skin look brighter and more even over time while keeping it moisturised overnight. It is usually gentler than a strong serum. Use it on clean skin at night and wear sunscreen every morning.
facts: Vitamin C is an antioxidant known for a brighter, more even look.
Pure vitamin C breaks down with air, light and heat.
A more even look usually takes 8–12 weeks.
Mirc Glow Glutathione Cream contains vitamin C.
